3_전문_SP.30199: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated jazz-influenced chords with a slight chorus effect. A smooth male tenor vocal leads with frequent use of falsetto and brea
3_전문_SP.30200: K-Rock power ballad. Clean electric guitar arpeggios in the verses transition to high-gain distorted rhythm guitars in the choruses. A melodic electric guitar solo features wide vibrato and legato phrasing. The drum kit uses a standard rock setup with prominent crash cymbals and a punchy snare. A synth pad provides harmonic density in the background. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with eighth-note drive. Male vocals range from a breathy baritone in the verses to powerful, belted tenor notes in the choruses with occasional grit. Key of E major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
3_전문_SP.30204: K-Rock track with flamenco influences. The arrangement features a nylon-string acoustic guitar performing rapid rasgueado and picado techniques, a distorted electric guitar playing power chords and lead lines, an electric bass, and a drum kit. The vocals are a powerful male tenor, shifting between melodic singing and gritty, belted delivery. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The song structure alternates between acoustic-driven flamenco sections and high-energy rock choruses with heavy distortion and driving percussion. The electric guitar uses a high-gain tone for the main riffs and a wah-pedal for soloistic flourishes.
3_전문_SP.30206: K-Pop power ballad. Features a prominent grand piano, a lush string section, and a powerful male tenor vocal. The arrangement builds from a sparse piano-and-vocal opening to a full orchestral climax with a standard drum kit and electric bass. The drums feature a heavy snare with long reverb and crashing cymbals during the chorus. Electric guitar provides subtle clean arpeggios in the verses and soaring, overdriven lead lines in the bridge and final chorus. The vocal performance is dynamic, moving from breathy low-register singing to high-belted notes and falsetto ad-libs. Key of E Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
3_전문_SP.30207: K-Pop, Funk-Pop. A high-energy arrangement featuring a prominent brass section with trumpets and saxophones, a slap bass guitar, and a syncopated electric guitar playing clean-tone funk scratches. The drum kit uses a tight, punchy snare and a driving kick pattern. A male lead vocal performs with a powerful, belt-heavy delivery, supported by layered group backing vocals and rhythmic chants. The track features a breakdown with a melodic flute solo and percussive cowbell accents. Key of G Major, 128 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
3_전문_SP.30201: K-Indie pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays jazz-influenced chords with a chorus effect and light reverb. A fretless electric bass provides melodic counterpoint with slides and vibrato. Drums feature a brushed snare and a soft, rounded kick drum. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate style with close-mic production. The arrangement includes subtle Rhodes piano accents and a clean electric guitar solo with melodic phrasing. Key of E Major, 82 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
3_전문_SP.30203: K-Pop City Pop with elements of Funk and Disco. Features a prominent slap bass line, clean electric guitar with rhythmic scratching and palm-muted riffs, and a bright brass section. Synthesizers include shimmering digital pads and a lead synth with a slight portamento. The drums use a crisp snare and a steady kick with occasional syncopated fills. A male vocalist performs with a smooth, melodic delivery, frequently shifting into falsetto during the chorus. The arrangement includes a breakdown with a slap bass solo and a rhythmic guitar bridge. Tempo is 118 BPM in the key of E Major.
3_전문_SP.30205: K-Indie ballad featuring female and male vocals. The arrangement begins with a delicate piano melody and atmospheric synth pads. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic accents with light chorus and delay. The percussion is minimal, utilizing a soft kick and subtle electronic snare hits. A warm synth bass enters during the second half. The track features a duet with breathy, emotive delivery. Key of E Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
3_전문_SP.30208: K-Pop ballad with folk-pop influences. The arrangement features a prominent fingerpicked acoustic guitar, a melodic violin, and a grand piano. A baritone male vocal delivers the verses with a breathy, intimate tone, transitioning to a powerful, belted chest voice in the choruses. The percussion is minimal, consisting of light shakers and occasional orchestral-style kick drum accents. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G Major. The violin plays lyrical counter-melodies throughout, while the piano provides harmonic weight with sustained chords and arpeggios in the higher register during the bridge.
